name: Streaming A Hybrid Blockchain And Smart Contract Framework For Resilient Iot Security In S 85C192C2C9
text: A hybrid blockchain and smart contract framework for resilient IoT security in smart homes identifies a tradeoff: centralized architectures create a single point of failure, while blockchain-only solutions introduce latency that limits real-time control. This qualifies Kaal's conditional claim that decentralized public blockchains can remove centralized-governance failures only when they are scalable and secure. The abstract concerns smart-home IoT control, not governance generally.
